# coralogix_team (Data Source)

Coralogix Team. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/user-management/create-and-manage-teams/.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coralogix_team" "example" {
  id = coralogix_team.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Team ID.

### Read-Only

- `daily_quota` (Number) Team quota. Optional, Default daily quota is 0.01 units/day.
- `name` (String) Team name.
- `retention` (Number) Team retention.
